svg.title: Unsupported distress days against psychologist workload
svg.desc: Trade-off curves of four alerting policies on the validation cohort; the same points are listed in the table below the chart.
svg.text: Unsupported distress days against psychologist workload
Validation cohort, simulated children. Lower and to the left is better. Points beyond a workload of 1 are not shown.
